intent: Fix identifiable issue/log defects; for reports lacking original causal evidence, implement tested incident-owned diagnostic collection in the report function, then close with explicit diagnostic-follow-up disposition as requested. Preserve concurrent branch changes.

closure_policy.source_fix: Close with source and matching behavioral evidence.
closure_policy.diagnostic_followup: User explicitly authorizes closing an unproven original incident after needed capture is implemented and tested; do not claim the historical failure was reproduced or fixed.
closure_policy.unknown_remote_outcome: No new write/model execution or resend is authorized by diagnostic collection.

planned_features: Bounded context-v5 incident diagnostic snapshot with strict app/service validation and approved legacy payload compatibility.
Owned provider/tool/acceptance receipt enrichment; retained safe snapshots for explicit manual problem-area selection.
Actual voice session/generation/capture/playback metrics and timing without text/audio content.
Report UI preview/refresh and explicit problem-area selection before approval; no post-approval data mutation.

validation.component_limits: Current production source with explicitly declared Android/environment boundaries; overlapping suite counts are not added; no Android lifecycle, JNI, OEM microphone or physical latency claim.

found_and_fixed: Redact complete follow-up text before applying final length bound; preserve raw UI text and reserve prefix space with visible length validation.
Clear preview events as well as snapshots when diagnostic capture is unavailable, preventing repeated DiagnosticsChanged rejection with general logging enabled.
independent_review.credential_fragment_negative_control: Previous helper reproduced synthetic ghp_ABC fragment; current helper regression passes.

concurrent_changes_preserved: Complete provider journal binding and exact checkpoint replay proof
Shared provider cooldown scheduling and current-row observation
Inline numbered voice link-label projection and legacy failure ownership
